playstyle.identity: Zoe is a trickster burst mage who one-shots with long-range bubbles and stars. She picks up summoner spells and item actives from minions.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers auto after abilities. Q throws a star - redirect for more distance/damage. W drops spell shards from minions (use enemy spells). E fires a sleepy bubble (through walls = longer range). R blinks then returns. E-Q-R for max range burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zoe spikes at level 3 and at 6 with poke. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong at picks with E.

passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.summary: After casting an ability, next auto deals bonus damage.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Zoe's next auto attack deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Paddle Star
abilities.summary: Throw a star; redirect it for more damage based on distance.
abilities.details: Zoe throws a star that she can redirect. It deals more damage the further it travels before hitting.

abilities.name: Spell Thief
abilities.summary: Collect spell shards from minions; cast enemy summoner spells.
abilities.details: Enemy summoner spells and item actives drop spell shards. Zoe can pick them up and cast them. Casting grants movement speed and orbs.

abilities.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
abilities.summary: Fire a bubble that puts enemies to sleep; travels farther through walls.
abilities.details: Zoe throws a bubble that makes the first enemy hit drowsy, then puts them to sleep. Travels farther if it passes through terrain.

abilities.name: Portal Jump
abilities.summary: Blink to a location, then return to original position.
abilities.details: Zoe teleports to a location, then automatically returns to her original position after a moment.
